about: Sixty sentences for measuring the verifier of the Desk: for each of twenty sets of passages, one sentence that the passages support, one that says something they do not say, and one that changes what they say in a small way. Everything in it is made up.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 arms to a second Brindle Logistics plant, at Tarnmoor.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 warehouse arms, built for tote picking and trailer unloading, to Brindle Logistics for its second plant, at Tarnmoor.

items.label: unsupported
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 arms to Brindle Logistics, which is its largest customer.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 warehouse arms, built for tote picking and trailer unloading, to Brindle Logistics for its second plant, at Tarnmoor.

items.flaw: The passage does not say that Brindle Logistics is the largest customer of Fixture Robotics.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 arms to the first Brindle Logistics plant, at Tarnmoor.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics has begun shipping FX-1 warehouse arms, built for tote picking and trailer unloading, to Brindle Logistics for its second plant, at Tarnmoor.

items.flaw: The second plant has become the first plant.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics lists the FX-1 from $38,000 per arm.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics lists the FX-1 from $38,000 per arm, with delivery within 12 weeks of an order.

items.label: unsupported
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics has cut the price of the FX-1 to $38,000 per arm.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics lists the FX-1 from $38,000 per arm, with delivery within 12 weeks of an order.

items.flaw: The passage gives a list price and says nothing of a price cut.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Fixture Robotics lists the FX-1 from $38,000 per arm, with delivery within 12 days of an order.

passages.quote: Fixture Robotics lists the FX-1 from $38,000 per arm, with delivery within 12 weeks of an order.

items.flaw: The delivery time of 12 weeks has become 12 days.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Tarnmoor is due to receive 60 arms by 30 November 2026.

passages.quote: Tarnmoor is due to receive 60 arms by 30 November 2026.

items.label: unsupported
items.sentence: Tarnmoor will use the 60 arms for inbound trailer unloading.

passages.quote: Tarnmoor is due to receive 60 arms by 30 November 2026.

items.flaw: The passage does not say what the arms will be used for.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Tarnmoor has received 60 arms by 30 November 2026.

passages.quote: Tarnmoor is due to receive 60 arms by 30 November 2026.

items.flaw: A delivery that is due has become a delivery that was made.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Brindle Logistics measured an 18 per cent cut in cycle time on tote-picking cells at Ashvale.

passages.quote: At Ashvale, Brindle Logistics measured an 18 per cent cut in cycle time on tote-picking cells, comparing the four weeks before and after the FX-1 arms went live.

items.label: unsupported
items.sentence: The 18 per cent cut in cycle time saved Brindle Logistics $2 million in a year.

passages.quote: At Ashvale, Brindle Logistics measured an 18 per cent cut in cycle time on tote-picking cells, comparing the four weeks before and after the FX-1 arms went live.

items.flaw: The passage gives no saving in money.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Brindle Logistics measured an 18 per cent cut in cycle time across all of its plants.

passages.quote: At Ashvale, Brindle Logistics measured an 18 per cent cut in cycle time on tote-picking cells, comparing the four weeks before and after the FX-1 arms went live.

items.flaw: A result at one site, on tote-picking cells, has become a result for every plant.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: The FX-1 is rated for a payload of 12 kg at full reach and a maximum reach of 1.4 m.

passages.quote: Rated payload: 12 kilograms at full reach.
Maximum reach: 1.4 metres from the base.

items.label: unsupported

passages.quote: Rated payload: 12 kilograms at full reach.
Maximum reach: 1.4 metres from the base.

items.flaw: The passages do not compare the arm with any other.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: The FX-1 is rated for a payload of 12 kg at full reach and a maximum reach of 1.6 m.

passages.quote: Rated payload: 12 kilograms at full reach.
Maximum reach: 1.4 metres from the base.

items.flaw: The maximum reach of 1.4 m has become 1.6 m.

items.label: supported

passages.quote: Throughput: up to 1.2k picks an hour.

passages.quote: Throughput: up to 1.2k picks an hour.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: The datasheet lists a typical throughput of 1,200 picks an hour.

passages.quote: Throughput: up to 1.2k picks an hour.

items.flaw: A figure given as an upper limit has become a typical figure.

items.label: supported

items.sentence: Fixture Robotics has deployed FX-1 arms to unload mixed cartons from trailers.

passages.quote: At its demo day, Fixture Robotics showed an FX-1 arm unloading mixed cartons from a trailer.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Dana Whitcombe, chief operating officer of Brindle Logistics, said that the company went from pilot to production in nine weeks.

passages.quote: "We went from pilot to production in nine weeks," said Dana Whitcombe, chief operating officer of Brindle Logistics.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Dana Whitcombe, chief operating officer of Fixture Robotics, said that the company went from pilot to production in nine weeks.

passages.quote: "We went from pilot to production in nine weeks," said Dana Whitcombe, chief operating officer of Brindle Logistics.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Northwind Machines said in a briefing that the Pallet Pilot moves pallets of up to 800 kg.

passages.quote: Northwind Machines said in a briefing that its Pallet Pilot robot moves pallets of up to 800 kilograms.

items.label: unsupported

passages.quote: Northwind Machines said in a briefing that its Pallet Pilot robot moves pallets of up to 800 kilograms.

items.label: supported

passages.quote: Hollis Dynamics released version 4.2 of its Hollis Nav software on 14 September 2026; the release adds support for two lidar models.

items.label: distorted

passages.quote: Hollis Dynamics released version 4.2 of its Hollis Nav software on 14 September 2026; the release adds support for two lidar models.

items.label: supported
items.sentence: Standard LSB-7 requires a safety-rated stop within 0.5 seconds for mobile robots over 50 kg.

passages.quote: Standard LSB-7 of the Lowmoor Safety Board requires a safety-rated stop within 0.5 seconds for mobile robots over 50 kilograms.

items.label: unsupported
items.sentence: Standard LSB-7 also requires an annual audit of every robot fleet.

passages.quote: Standard LSB-7 of the Lowmoor Safety Board requires a safety-rated stop within 0.5 seconds for mobile robots over 50 kilograms.

items.flaw: The passage mentions no audit.

items.label: distorted
items.sentence: Standard LSB-7 requires a safety-rated stop within 0.5 seconds for all mobile robots.

passages.quote: Standard LSB-7 of the Lowmoor Safety Board requires a safety-rated stop within 0.5 seconds for mobile robots over 50 kilograms.

items.flaw: A requirement for robots over 50 kg has become a requirement for all of them.

items.label: supported

passages.quote: Quarry Robotics said its Q-Haul truck is rated to haul 40 tonnes per trip.

passages.quote: Tarn Mobility plans to open a plant in Brindle by 2028, Gantry Daily reported, citing two people familiar with the plan.
